notes.title: Playtests are now open
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215082/f610b1da4191d6f9d6c8a1b5286976d4f48904a1.png

Dear Players and Media Friends,

We are thrilled to announce that our game Blacksmith Simulator has entered the playtesting phase! This is a fantastic opportunity to step into the shoes of a blacksmith, try out new features, and contribute to the game's development.
 
Why participate in the playtests?

 Exclusive access: Be among the first to play the latest version of the game.
 Your feedback matters: Your input will help us improve Blacksmith Simulator.
 Test and explore: Discover various aspects of the game, explore new possibilities, and report any issues.

How to join the playtests?
[olist]
 Visit the game's Steam page: Blacksmith Simulator on Steam
 Click "Request Access" under the playtest section.
 Have fun!
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215082/d2e9660374bf525a9223ff177651a8b25f48101c.png

[previewyoutube=tAC9XqTPhpo;full][/previewyoutube]

Share your thoughts!

We encourage you to share your feedback on our forums, social media, and directly with our team. Your opinion is incredibly valuable and will help us create the best possible version of Blacksmith Simulator.

By participating in platetsts and giving us feedback about the game we give keys for the full version of the game.

FEEDBACK post on our Discord: https://discord.gg/VakXrgeRsC

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to hearing your feedback!

Best regards,
Blacksmith Simulator Team
